description: Animated player movement in FieldView: Players move along their routes following timestamps, with time slider, play/pause controls, speed control, and trail/estela visualization. Works for all tracking modes.
steps: Add animation state (currentTime, isPlaying, playbackSpeed) and controls to FieldView.tsx
Implement time interpolation logic to compute player positions at any given timestamp
Render player trail (polyline of points up to current time) and current position circle
Add time slider, play/pause button, and speed selector controls below the field
Ensure animation works for all modes: individual, group, ball carrier
Verify frontend builds and tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Player circles move along the field following their route points interpolated by timestamp
A time slider controls which moment is being visualized
Trail/estela shows the path the player has already traveled up to the current time
Play/Pause button starts/stops automatic animation playback
Animation works for all tracking modes (single player, group, ball carrier)
